name: discover-layer-mapping-sets-full
description: The `mapping_sets` layer's descriptor at `form: "full"` — the one form that carries the descriptor PROSE, asked for one layer at a time because the project-wide `full` discovery is REFUSED with `over-budget` on every project (`negative/discover-project-full-over-budget.json`), and the refusal's second step is exactly this request. Together the fifteen per-layer `full` vectors replay every layer, kind and field annotation the model contract ships, verbatim, which is where the shipped-prose oracle (`packages/tools/tests/test_model_contract_conformance.py`) rides: rewording an annotation in the contract is a protocol-output change, and this is the output it changes. Of this layer: the layer contract `7.0.0` added, whose one top-level kind carries a `maps` collection whose members are identified by the `application` field rather than by a `name`, and whose member kind `map` declares two references into one layer — the one shape a `relation` could not express. It is, with `base_types`, `application_types` and the three layers of the forms a type names by reference (`units`, `compu_methods`, `data_constraints`), one of the six layers of a complete project that may legally hold no element at all.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` shape of a SWCraft project: fifteen scaffolded layers, `mapping_sets` among them, stored in `data_types/mapping_sets/` and empty, which is legal — a project whose interfaces are typed by implementation types alone declares no set. Nothing about the response depends on which elements are in the layer: the inventory is derived from the model contract through the registry, not from the files.

layers.description: Data type mapping sets, one file each under `data_types/mapping_sets/`. A set pairs each application type — the physical view of a signal, with its unit, its conversion and its range — with the implementation type that stores it, and a component names the sets its behaviour maps with. Every application type or enumeration a component's ports speak in has to be paired in one of them, because generated code needs to know what stores it. The directory is mandatory and may be empty: a project whose interfaces are typed by implementation types alone needs no set.

element_kinds.description: One mapping set, emitted as a `DATA-TYPE-MAPPING-SET`. It holds the pairs that say which implementation type stores each application type. A component references the set as a whole, so one set serves every component that names it, and a project is free to keep one set for the whole model or one per domain.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The set's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/mapping_sets/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the layer, must not be blank, and immutable.

fields.name: maps
fields.description: The pairs the set declares, addressed by the application type each one maps, which appears at most once in a set. The order is the model's and is the order the pairs are emitted in. An empty list is legal and declares nothing.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free text about the set. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

fields.name: package
fields.description: The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/MappingSets`, its layer's package, this mapping set is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the mapping set and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/MappingSets/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/MappingSets` itself. SWCraft's importers record it for an element whose source path is exactly `/DataTypes/MappingSets/{package}/{name}`, SWCraft's own layout, so a project's export imports back placed; and for an element that would otherwise share `/DataTypes/MappingSets` with a name differing from its own only in case. An author may set it to place an element or to resolve such a collision. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule.

element_kinds.description: One pair: the application type, and the implementation type that stores it. Both sides name a declared data type by its own name; which kinds each side may name is checked across files, because the answer is in the type's own file and not here.

fields.name: application
fields.description: The name of the declared application type, enumeration, record or array this pair maps, an element of the `application_types` layer. It is the pair's identity inside the set, and so immutable.

fields.name: implementation
fields.description: The name of the declared value type, reference type, implementation record or implementation array that stores it, and never a pointer. Repointing the pair at another implementation type edits this field; pairing a different application type is a different pair.

expected.notes: The same document the default form answers with `description` restored on the layer, on every kind and on every field that declares one, and with the three descriptor booleans spelled out where the default form omits them at `false` — `optional` on the layer, `required` and `immutable` on every field. Nothing else is restored, because nothing else is left out. `baseline` is the stand-in token every vector carries; a harness replaces it with the project's own.
